messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] PROD -> inference-runtime: elevated 5xx/timeouts observed across gateway (us-west-2). Multiple segfaults and OOMs reported from model-runner processes. Pager: <https://pagerduty.example/INC12345|INC12345>

alex g.: acked, I'm oncall and looking.
maria: seeing ~15% 5xx on /v1/generate. Errors include \"segfault\" and \"out of memory\" in runner logs. Affected model: redwood/llama-13b-v2-quant
chris: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T12:11:24Z] model-runner[pid=8123]: segfault at 0x7f... in attention_kernel
[2026-03-15T12:11:25Z] gpu0: oom during allocate for kv_cache size=1.2GB
```
taylor: rough impact estimate: ~1.2k req/min failing at peak, interactive flows hitting >5s latency. Some proxied customers reporting errors.
alex g.: mitigation plan (short): 1) enable fallback routing to model-legacy-13b spare 2) reduce max_batch_tokens -> 512 on gateway 3) cordon + restart nodes with repeated OOMs 4) collect core dumps and upload for ML infra analysis
ops: executing fallback now
ops: ```
# enable fallback route
redwoodctl routes update --route inference --fallback model-legacy-13b
# tweak batching
redwoodctl config set runtime.max_batch_tokens=512 --env prod
```
ops: fallback enabled, traffic shift starting (~12:15Z) -> legacy showing ~6% of traffic now
maria: cordoning node-42 and node-43 due to repeated OOM/segfaults, restarting runner services
chris: grabbing core dump + stack traces now:
```
sudo coredumpctl dump -o /tmp/core-8123
tar czf core-8123.tgz /tmp/core-8123
aws s3 cp core-8123.tgz s3://redwood-core-dumps/INC12345/
```
ops: uploaded cores -> https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-core-dumps/INC12345/core-8123.tgz
taylor: temporary hotfix: switch KV cache eviction to aggressive (lower memory footprint) to reduce pressure, enabling now
alex g.: applied kv eviction change, monitoring memory and 5xx
maria: after fallback + restarts + kv tweak, 5xx dropped from ~15% -> ~5% over last 10m
chris: early analysis: backtrace points to potential use-after-free in custom attention kernel when sequence length + quantization path combine; reproducible in internal test harness with small batch sizes. Captured symbols and repro steps in S3 path.
alex g.: notify ML-infra and runtime kernel owners, probable next steps: either pin model to quant-v1.1 or roll back latest qkernel patch; need to reproduce reliably before rollback.
eng-oncall: taking handoff. Summary for follow-up: fallback routing enabled, batch tokens reduced to 512, two nodes cordoned & restarted, core dumps uploaded, current error rate ~5% and stable but degraded. ML-infra + runtime team to debug segfault root cause.
eng-oncall: Handoff notes: INC12345 | paged @ 2026-03-15T12:11Z | current state: degraded but stabilizing | remediation: fallback + config changes | follow-ups: ML infra reproduce & patch, runtime to consider kernel rollback or safe-guards for kv allocs. Assigning to @maria, @chris.
alex g.: adding preliminary timeline & mitigation steps to postmortem doc: https://confluence.redwood/INC12345
maria: tagging affected customers for outreach: acct-502, acct-778 - outreach in progress, CS informed.
ops: leaving enhanced debug logging enabled for 2h, will auto-disable.
eng-oncall: closing the page for primary responders; monitoring alerts remain active. If error rate creeps back up, re-open incident and escalate. :thumbsup:
